The file is for data import.


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Load the litters and pups datasets

```{r}
litters_df <-
  read_csv(
    file = "data/FAS_litters.csv",
           na = c("","NA","."))

litters_df = janitor::clean_names(litters_df)

pups_df = 
  read_csv(
    file = "data/FAS_pups.csv",
    skip = 3,
    na = c("","NA","."))

pups_df = janitor::clean_names(pups_df)

```
